title: Explicit linear cohomology pullback over a common affine base
statement: Let R be a commutative ring, X and Y schemes [def-pc-scheme], f:Y→Spec R and fprime:X→Spec R, d:X→Y with d followed by f equal to fprime, M a module on Y, and phi:M→d_*O_X. Define a linear map HOver(f,M,n)→HOver(fprime,O_X,n) [def-pc-flat-cohomology-comparison] by the exact inverse-image Ext map with inverse constant-integer comparison, followed by Sheaf.H.map of coeff d phi. The map is R-linear by coefficient naturality and the structural-scalar identity from d followed by f equal to fprime; it is defined without any choice of an equivalence.

source.place: cohomology-equation-functorial; exact inverse-image action on Ext, and Mathlib adjunction and unit pullback APIs

proof.text: Construct the cohomology comparison using cohomologyComparisonLinear. Apply appTop to the equation d followed by f equals fprime to identify structural scalars. coeff_naturality and smulHom_naturality establish linearity.

proof_origin.place: The explicit Ext comparison, naturality and functoriality; the complete argument is in the Lean docstring.

lean.statement: def unitCohomologyPullbackLinear {R : Type u} [CommRing R] {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : Y ⟶ Spec (.of R)) (f' : X ⟶ Spec (.of R)) (d : X ⟶ Y) (hd : d ≫ f = f') (M : Y.Modules) (φ : M ⟶ (pushforward d).obj (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)) (n : ℕ) : HOver f M n →ₗ[R] HOver f' (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf) n
